desc: Implement suffix DP with strict compatibility `next_start > current_end` and capacity at most 4.
Represent candidates as `(score, tuple(sorted(original_indices)))` and compare score descending, then tuple ascending.
Confirm that sorting selected original indices before every comparison enforces the required output ordering.
Run the provided examples and targeted edge-case tests, including equal scores, shared boundaries, all-overlapping intervals, fewer than four intervals, and empty-selection behavior.
